.. change::
    :tags: feature, operations

    Added :class:`.AutocommitOp`, an operation container that groups a
    series of migration operations so that they render and execute inside
    an autocommit block, along with the :meth:`.Operations.autocommit_block`
    context manager that proxies
    :meth:`.MigrationContext.autocommit_block` to the ``op.`` namespace.
    Tools such as
    :paramref:`.EnvironmentContext.configure.process_revision_directives`
    may now wrap autogenerated operations in an :class:`.AutocommitOp`
    group, which renders as a ``with op.autocommit_block():`` block and
    executes its sub-operations in order through the standard
    :class:`.Operations` dispatch.  Reversing a group reverses its
    sub-operations in reverse order; groups containing non-reversible
    operations, nested autocommit groups, and interactions with
    :meth:`.Operations.batch_alter_table` are rejected with clear errors.
